caveats: New PCG64 seed602 100-by-30 instance. Common b is scaled by 1/(1.1 max|b|), making x=0 strictly feasible for the logarithmic loss. This follows the CVXOPT input convention; its source explicitly says its own data differ from the book. Unlike the old CVXOPT least-squares branch, the right-hand side is actually -b rather than a zero vector.
